title: GASS Records — three type voices: grotesk, swash, chunky
note: Neue Haas Grotesk Display 400 set huge (~135px) in tight uppercase does all the reading. Against it: a calligraphic swash wordmark (drawn from Millionaire by Altiplano) and pill badges in HWT Bulletin / Perfetto. Small labels are the same grotesk at 11px 600 caps. Neutral workhorse + one ornate script + one chunky display face.
